items.question: Why does DeepWalk's stochastic gradient descent optimization make it outperform LINE(2nd) on the DBLP(PaperCitation) network?
items.false_premise: DeepWalk is optimized by stochastic gradient descent and therefore outperforms LINE(2nd) on the DBLP(PaperCitation) network.
items.correction: LINE(2nd) is the model directly optimized by stochastic gradient descent, and on the DBLP(PaperCitation) network LINE(2nd) significantly outperforms DeepWalk.
items.evidence_quote: The LINE model directly optimized by stochastic gradient descent, LINE(2nd), does not perform well as expected.

items.question: Under which conditions does DeepWalk become better than LINE(2nd) after the network is reconstructed by adding second-order neighbors for high-degree vertices?
items.false_premise: DeepWalk becomes better than LINE(2nd) after reconstruction that adds second-order neighbors for high-degree vertices.
items.correction: After reconstructing the network by recursively adding neighbors of neighbors for vertices with small degrees, LINE(2nd) significantly increases and outperforms DeepWalk.
items.evidence_quote: However, by reconstructing the network through recursively adding neighbors of neighbors for vertices with small degrees (smaller than 500), the performance of LINE(2nd) significantly increases and outperforms DeepWalk.

items.question: How does LINE(2nd) use random walks to reach other references in the paper citation network, and why does that help it beat DeepWalk?
items.false_premise: LINE(2nd) uses random walks to reach other references in the paper citation network and that is why it beats DeepWalk.
items.correction: The random walk on the paper citation network can only reach papers along the citing path and cannot reach other references, while LINE(2nd) represents each paper with its references.
items.evidence_quote: This is because the random walk on the paper citation network can only reach papers along the citing path (i.e., older papers) and cannot reach other references.

items.question: What explains why DeepWalk significantly outperforms LINE(2nd) on the DBLP(PaperCitation) network, and how does the citation-path limitation of LINE(2nd) contribute to that result?
items.false_premise: DeepWalk significantly outperforms LINE(2nd) on the DBLP(PaperCitation) network because LINE(2nd) is limited by citation paths.
items.correction: On the DBLP(PaperCitation) network, LINE(2nd) significantly outperforms DeepWalk, and the cited limitation is a drawback of random walks rather than of LINE(2nd).
